title: An Orchestra for the Rain
learning_objectives: Find a detail stated in the text
Retell or summarize ideas in order
parent_prompts: Before reading: What do you predict from the title?
During reading: Which words support your idea?
After reading: Why did the result happen, or how do you know the main idea?

pages.text: At first light, Nia found a puzzling mark beside the rain. It was too regular to be an accident, yet too faint to explain itself. Rather than announce a discovery, Nia copied its shape and measured the spaces between its edges. The group wrote down the exact clue, considered another possible meaning, and checked the place again before moving on. This patient habit kept an attractive guess from becoming a false conclusion.

pages.text: Behind the corner lay an ordinary object placed in an extraordinary way. Nia felt a burst of triumph, then paused. Finding an object was not the same as understanding why someone had placed it there. The group wrote down the exact clue, considered another possible meaning, and checked the place again before moving on. This patient habit kept an attractive guess from becoming a false conclusion.
